name: standmeet-google-calendar-mcp
description: Google Calendar as a BLOCK: data (spec.yaml + binding.yaml) + the generic openapi-runtime engine (engine.js / engine_call.js, vendored in-block the way socket blocks vendor gateway.js so the block is self-contained for the sandbox and dsh pack). No provider-specific code, no Go. The host merges the owner's OAuth access token into each call; this block does the HTTP. Replaces the in-host calendarAdapter (docs/design/plugin/openapi-runtime-block.md).
